🍬 CANDY SHOP is back this Friday and the sugar rush starts at the decks 🎧

DJ Ralphy Ray is running the booth all night — bass dripping like syrup, beats sticky enough to keep you on la pista till close. This is the flavor Pasco's been missing on a Friday, and it's become the habit nobody's skipping.

Curls, shades, and a lollipop in hand — you know the vibe. Candy Shop isn't just a party, it's THE Friday. Every week a new flavor, every week a new reason to pull up.

Tell your crew. Clear your Friday. The shop opens at 9. 🍭

📅 Friday, November 6 | Doors 9pm–2am
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 $5 Cover | Ladies free before 11pm
🔞 18+ to party, 21+ to drink
